title: bddo:bfloat16 is the upper half of a binary32 value
description: 3F C0 is the top sixteen bits of 3F C0 00 00, which is 1.5; C0 00 is -2.0. As binary16 the same bytes would be 1.9375 and -2.0, so the first value shows the format is honoured. A field with no bddo:floatFormat stays IEEE 754: 3C 00 is 1.0.
